COUNT_CANAIS: SELECT COUNT(c.id) as total FROM Canal c INNER JOIN CanalUsuarioAdmin cua ON c.id = cua.id_canal WHERE cua.id_usuario = ?

SELECT_CANAIS: SELECT c.* FROM Canal c INNER JOIN CanalUsuarioAdmin cua ON c.id = cua.id_canal WHERE cua.id_usuario = ? ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

UPDATE_CANAL: UPDATE Canal SET nome = ?, descricao = ?, thumbnail = ?, modified_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND id IN (SELECT id_canal FROM CanalUsuarioAdmin WHERE id_usuario = ?)
